title: HOKA Ultra-Trail Australia by UTMB 2027 — Mandatory Gear
publisher: USM Events Pty Ltd / UTMB World Series
claims: UTA is a cupless event and athletes are advised to carry their own cup, bottle or hydration vest for drinks at aid stations, and to carry water between checkpoints.

Common mandatory items across UTAMiler, UTA100, UTA50, UTA22 and UTA11 are a long-sleeve thermal top, a waterproof and breathable jacket, a beanie/balaclava/buff, a mobile phone, an A5 emergency instruction card, a whistle, an emergency space blanket or light bivvy, a compression bandage of at least 7.5 cm by 2.3 m unstretched, 2 litres of water capacity (1 litre for UTA11), two food bars or portions per leg, a rubbish ziplock bag, a race number and a timing tag for the backpack.

UTAMiler, UTA100 and UTA50 additionally require a high-visibility safety vest complying with AS/NZS 4602 and worn between 8:00pm and 6:00am, a headlamp, a small backup light and a dry sack or zip-lock bags.

UTAMiler and UTA100 additionally require long leg thermal pants and full-fingered lightweight thermal gloves, plus weather-dependent long waterproof pants and a 100-weight long-sleeve synthetic fleece top.
For UTA22 and UTA11 the thermal top and waterproof jacket are weather-dependent items, and only UTA22 and UTA11 runners are exempt from the headlamp and high-visibility vest.
Weather-dependent rulings are announced at 10:00am on Wednesday 13 May for UTA11, 9:00am on Thursday 14 May for UTA22 and UTAMiler, and 10:00am on Friday 15 May for UTA100.

UTA100 and UTAMiler runners must complete a mandatory gear check before collecting the race pack, either at a partner store until 12 May or at race check-in; no gear means no start, random checks apply and missing items can bring a time penalty.
The waterproof jacket must have fully taped rather than critically taped seams and a hood, and the phone must be charged with a working SIM card.
